name: hit_steel
for: any blade or weapon parried/blocked on steel (hero parry, shieldbearer block, armoured bosses)
notes: Hot white-yellow sparks with a cold steel glint; they arc out (biased up and toward +x), fall, bounce and skitter on the floor, cooling to dark red. Anchor = the clash point. The floor the sparks land on is baked 74 px (1.17 m) below the anchor, so play it at about chest height; mirror x when the blow comes from the right. Built at the hero's density (117 px / 1.85 m). 12 frames @ 12 fps, 1 s.
